scope: gang cleanup owner and house ordering
SET MAXPAGES/MAXGOSSIP/MAXAUCTION range and counter behavior

native_findings.finding: PAGE=1; counters=0; MAXPAGES/MAXGOSSIP/MAXAUCTION=3; communication flags initialize with TELEPATH block clear.
MESSAGES -> record+0x3B; flags +0x700 -> +0x3C; display flags +0x7D4 -> +0x6A; MAXPAGES -> +0x3E; MAXGOSSIP -> +0xA9; MAXAUCTION -> +0xAA.
The same persisted fields restore directly into live profile fields; zero MAX* legacy values are compatibility-normalized after load.
PAGE toggles live +0x6E1 and requests save, but +0x6E1 is absent from the recovered persisted profile map.
SET TELEPATH ON clears bit 0x20 (do not block); OFF sets bit 0x20 (block future telepaths).
SET MAX* uses atol; values >255 are capped to 255; otherwise AL is stored, preserving low-byte wrap for negative values.
page/telepath, gossip and auction receive counters are zeroed by the native fast update.
GOSSIP/AUCTION rejects only when current counter > configured maximum, then increments an 8-bit counter.
telepath checks page counter against MAXPAGES with the same pre-increment boundary and block flag.
Leader disband marks the gang and strips connected members immediately; offline former members remain in the native member count.
An offline former member loading a disbanded gang has lieutenant state stripped, gang member count decremented, receives the disband notice, and loses the gang field.
gang record is deleted during cleanup when member count is zero (or force-delete flag bit 0x2 is set); only then can the name be recreated.
tax/deed/room cleanup occurs before MajorMUD user cleanup and final gang-record sweep; deed can be restored to deed shop and unprotected house contents are cleaned.
